description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Best Material & Durability: Made from 5mm plywood each layer and 3mm acrylic. 

 

  • Easy to Customize: To make our stations personalized for the man in your life, we can print any logo, drawing, picture, or word on our docking stations.

 

  • Gift of love: Our docking stations is a perfect gift for your husband, father, grandfather, boyfriend, brother, son, or friend in special occasions. This is a perfect gift for that personal touch!

 

  • Keep everything organized: It holds your Phone, Wallet, Rings, Watch, Keys, Glasses, and Miscellaneous items all in one place. It keeps all everyday essentials organized and easy to locate.

 

  • Easy to use: Easy to assemble just slide the back piece through the holes on the front, no glue, screws, or nails required. Perfectly placed slots allow you to easily thread your charger cord to your phone with no frustration.

 

SPECIFICATION

 

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly

 

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days average (US)

 

  • Packaging: 1x Custom Docking Station With Acrylic Photo

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway 
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
